querystring.select: SELECT A.COMPNT_VALUE AS compntValue, B.PROD_COMPNT_NAME as prodCompntName
querystring.from: FROM dbo.PROD_D A WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.REF_PROD_COMPNT B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.REF_PROD_COMPNT_CODE=B.REF_PROD_COMPNT_CODE
querystring.where: WHERE A.PROD_H_ID = {0} AND B.IS_PROD_HO=1 AND B.REF_PROD_COMPNT_GRP_CODE='GEN'
